index.title: St. Expedite Press
index.description: Night-minded books from New Orleans: original Southern fiction, archival recovery, translation, and experimental literary instruments from St. Expedite Press.

press.title: Press
press.description: St. Expedite Press publishes original Southern experimental writing, recovery editions, and translation from New Orleans.
press.introTitle: What the press prints and sells.
press.introText: Original Southern fiction, recovery editions, and translation, plus the store, the premise behind the whole thing, and the means to keep it running.

books.title: Books
books.description: The St. Expedite Press catalog: original work from Southern Experimental Press, Southern recovery editions, and translation selected for formal and spiritual pressure.
books.introText: Original experimental work, archival recovery, and translation under one publishing standard.

preorder.title: Pre-order
preorder.description: Lift Wind / Love Heat: Symphony No. 1 in C Minor is complete and now in editing and typesetting, with direct orders open through St. Expedite Press.
preorder.introText: Symphony No. 1 in C Minor. The manuscript is complete and is now in editing and typesetting. Editions of the main collection and its translation-and-essays companion can be ordered directly from the press.

orderThanks.title: Order received
orderThanks.description: Your order with St. Expedite Press has been received.
orderThanks.introText: Payment went through and the press has your details.

store.title: Store
store.description: Books, prints, and objects from St. Expedite Press, loaded live from the shop.
store.introTitle: Books when they exist. Prints when they mean something.
store.introText: Objects from the press's working life.

about.title: About
about.description: The mission of St. Expedite Press: gather the scattered limbs of Southern writing and rebuild a literary institution outside the approval systems that flatten it.
about.introText: Osiris was killed by Set and scattered. Isis gathered his limbs and reconstituted him. We take the same disposition toward Southern writing.

donate.title: Donate
donate.description: Support the press directly. One-time contributions sustain the catalog, the archive work, and what comes next.
donate.introText: A one-time contribution goes straight into publishing, archive work, and what comes next.

donateThanks.title: Donation
donateThanks.description: Donation confirmation for St. Expedite Press.
donateThanks.subtitle: Support received
donateThanks.introText: Your support enters the ongoing work directly.

lab.title: Lab
lab.description: St. Expedite Lab designs distinctive digital products and agent systems for founders: aesthetic interfaces, memory and knowledge layers, and specialized creative agents.
lab.introTitle: Aesthetic systems, memory layers, and specialized agents.
lab.introText: The Lab works with founders and small teams building unusual products in creative and cultural domains. Signal Atlas is the flagship demonstration: interface design, ontology, memory, retrieval, and agents treated as one system.

labInstruments.title: Instruments
labInstruments.description: Experimental instruments from St. Expedite Press, including the American Anglossic Compass.
labInstruments.introText: Forty prompts across five axes, scored against seven archetypes, resolving into an interpretive profile. Runs in the browser in a few minutes.

labArchitecture.title: Architecture
labArchitecture.description: How the St. Expedite public assistant is built: the request path, where authorization and limits are enforced, and the capabilities the public profile is denied.
labArchitecture.introTitle: How the public assistant is built and bounded.
labArchitecture.introText: The request path, the point at which each control is applied, and the capabilities the public profile is denied. The denial list and limits are generated from the profile configuration.

labPractice.title: Practice
labPractice.description: Commissioned work for founders and small teams: aesthetic product systems, memory and knowledge layers, specialized creative agents, and the infrastructure that runs them.
labPractice.introTitle: Distinctive products need design and intelligence to share a structure.
labPractice.introText: The Lab combines aesthetic direction, interfaces, memory architecture, knowledge graphs, retrieval, and specialized agents for creative-domain products.

labSchedule.title: Schedule
labSchedule.description: Request a free 30-minute introductory consultation with St. Expedite Lab about a product, agent system, memory layer, or creative-technology project.
labSchedule.introText: A first conversation to establish what you are building, where the difficult part is, and whether the Lab is a fit. No charge and no obligation after.

connect.title: Submit / Contact
connect.description: The protected St. Expedite Press portal for manuscript submissions, rights and press, collaborations, and general correspondence.
connect.introTitle: One gated portal for submissions and correspondence.
connect.introText: Manuscripts and messages pass through a Turnstile-protected service. The public chatbot remains separate and cannot access files or email.
